services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Along with Great Lakes Schooner Company and Cruise Toronto, our boats offer a perfect venue for corporate events, meetings, and teambuilding. Choose any one of our 3 fine charter boats ranging from Challenge our 96' three-masted schooner which accommodates up to 70 people, Kajama our 165' three-masted schooner which accommodates up to 225 people and Obsession III our modern motor yacht which accommodates up to 190 people. We customize each and every cruise to meet our client's expectations. Arranging a corporate event can be challenging, so let us do the work for you. blurb: Guests sail aboard the Kajama, a traditional tall ship, enjoying views of Toronto Harbour and Lake Ontario. The experience includes opportunities to assist in hoisting sails and learn about sailing. The ship offers day and evening cruises, private charters, corporate events, weddings, and educational outings.
